metadata.article_title: Documents executed by several persons at different times.

article.title: Documents executed by several persons at different times.
article.content: Where there are several persons executing a document at different times, such document may be presented for registration and re-registration within four months from the date of each execution.
article.html:
24Documents executed by several persons at different times.

Section 24 · Part IV · page 17 of the Act

Where there are several persons executing a document at different times, such document may be presented for registration and re-registration within four months from the date of each execution.
